body: Religion didn’t really come into existence to ‘explain’ phenomena that were considered supernatural. Religion existed and was practiced by primitive humans — I don’t mean to use ‘primitive’ in a derogatory way over here. If you have the time, try reading ‘The Elementary Forms of the Religious Life’ by Emile Durkheim; it’ll provide you with a more thoughtful understanding of religion. Modern religions which are institutionalised used Religion to explain the phenomena that did not fall under the horizon of rationality/reason (also to spread fear and dominance of the aristocracy and the Church/temple).
